answer: In the OECD Recommendation on AI, the 'AI system lifecycle' refers to the typical phases that an AI system goes through, which include planning and design; collecting and processing data; building and/or adapting models to specific tasks; testing, evaluating, verifying, and validating; making the system available for use/deploying; operating and monitoring; and retiring/decommissioning. These phases often occur in an iterative manner and are not necessarily sequential.
